messages.body: diffgate plan: SPEC section 4 swaps the command token in EVERY S1 review brief (reviews 1, 2 and 3) to '/sc:spec-panel-diffgate <args> --diffgate-dir <dir> --expect-round <N>'. Owner decision says the review-3 brief stays unchanged, incl. 'any finding of any severity is FAIL'. Which do the brief templates do? (a) RECOMMENDED: review-3 brief keeps every word verbatim, incl. the FAIL sentence; only the command token is substituted (without it review 3 would not use diffgate at all and the ledger chain breaks). (b) review-3 brief fully untouched, plain /sc:spec-panel at review 3.
